newsitem.title: USA: Teva says Copaxone is approved by FDA.
newsitem.headline: Teva says Copaxone is approved by FDA.

text.p: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has granted marketing clearance for its drug Copaxone, which is used to treat patients with relapsing remitting multiple sclerosis.
The drug was approved in Israel in 1996, where it will become available at the end of the year, the company said. The drug will be available in the U.S. in early 1997, it added.
It will be marketed in the U.S. by Teva Marion Partners -- a partnership between Teva and Hoechst Marion Roussel Inc., the company said.
